name: Fletcher
title: 6 Unassisted Pull-Ups
blurb: No kicking, no boost - just Fletcher and the bar. He's working up to 6 clean, unassisted pull-ups in a row before the year is over, with rest days built in. Beat 6 and the prize pool grows!

log.note: First workout! 25-second dead hang. Can't quite get a pull-up yet - so close.
31-second dead hang - Hang Tough unlocked! Went one extra second just to be sure.

milestones.title: Hang Tough
milestones.desc: Dead hang from the bar for 30 seconds.

milestones.title: Slow and Strong
milestones.desc: Do 5 slow negative pull-ups (jump up, lower down for 3+ seconds).

milestones.title: Super Six
milestones.desc: 6 unassisted pull-ups in a row. GRAND PRIZE! (Beat it and we'll add a bonus round.)

sideQuests.title: Dead Hang
sideQuests.desc: Hang from the bar as long as you can. 30 seconds unlocks Hang Tough!
